prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: shared restaurant photography for a DineSense landing-page composition round. Primary request: a single original editorial photograph of a beautiful plate of handmade rigatoni at a neighborhood Italian restaurant at night. Scene/backdrop: lived-in restaurant table with softly suggested room and candle glow in the background, evening dining scene. Subject: the pasta dish and a small portion of the table; no people in the focal plane. Style/medium: high-end natural food editorial photography, tactile and believable, not glossy commercial stock. Composition/framing: wide landscape image with the plate concentrated on the right half and calm dark negative space on the left, suitable for cropping in both wide and split-hero web layouts. Lighting/mood: low warm candlelight with gentle natural falloff and visible texture in the food; intimate, confident, after-dark. Color palette: warm browns, deep olive, parchment highlights and quiet ember tones; let the image look naturally lit rather than color graded. Materials/textures: handmade pasta, ceramic plate, linen napkin, wood tabletop. Constraints: no lettering, logos, UI, watermark, artificial blur, or impossible food details. Do not make this resemble a chain restaurant advertisement.
usage: Unused by the current website; original provenance preserved.
